spec.title: Open connections and in-flight requests (server)
spec.description: Little's Law check: in-flight is about rate x latency. Keep-alive ON: open connections stay near the VU count. OFF: fluctuates with connection churn.

spec.title: k6 connect time and latency (native histograms)
spec.description: Client-side view from k6 native histograms (no _bucket suffix). Needs Prometheus started with native histograms enabled. With keep-alive ON, connecting is ~0 for reused connections.

spec.title: Node process CPU: user vs system
spec.description: 1.0 = one full core. JS runs on one thread, so ~1.0 total means the event loop is saturated.

spec.title: Host CPU by mode (share of all cores)
spec.description: Includes k6, Prometheus, Grafana as well as Node. softirq = packet processing.

spec.expr: sum by (mode)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",mode=~"user|system|softirq|irq|iowait|steal"}[$__rate_interval])) / on() group_left() count(count by (cpu)(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node"}))

spec.title: Kernel share of Node process CPU
spec.description: Expect a clearly higher kernel share with keep-alive OFF.

spec.title: k6 dropped iterations
spec.description: Above 0 = k6 could not start requests on schedule. Discard the run.

spec.title: k6 failed requests
spec.description: Look for 'cannot assign requested address' in k6 output when this rises.

spec.title: Offered (k6) vs handled (server) rps
spec.description: Lines should match. k6 below your RATE = generator bottleneck. Server below k6 = failures or queueing. /metrics scrapes are excluded.

spec.title: Host CPU busy (generator headroom proxy)
spec.description: k6 runs on this host. Keep well under ~70%.

spec.title: Conntrack usage (only if Docker NAT in path)
spec.description: No data is normal for loopback / host networking.

spec.title: Server latency p50 / p99
spec.description: Server-side handler time only. It does NOT include TCP connect time. Top bucket is 1 s, so values clamp at 1 s.

spec.title: New connections per second
spec.description: Server counter is the exact number for Node. Host counters include Prometheus scrapes and, on loopback, k6's side too.

spec.title: Connections per request
spec.description: Keep-alive ON: close to 0. Keep-alive OFF: close to 1.

spec.title: Socket states (node_exporter)
spec.description: Steady-state TIME_WAIT is about new_conns_per_sec x 60 s. Compare with your prediction.

spec.title: TIME_WAIT as % of ephemeral port range
spec.description: Assumes range 32768..60999 (28232 ports). If you change ip_local_port_range, edit this query.

spec.title: 1. The verdict: did capacity and latency change?
3. CPU: where does the extra work land (user vs kernel)?
4. Validity checks: is this run trustworthy?
